name: Hexi Corridor dust event

aoi.label: Hexi Corridor, Gansu / Inner Mongolia margin

why_this_case: The corridor is a dust transport and source-region interpretation area linking Gobi/desert margins with downwind northern China.
The AOI is narrow enough for medium-scale VIIRS corrected-reflectance plume localization while still covering coarse regional dust context.
Sentinel-2 imagery near the event date is available as high-resolution supporting context, but not same-day dust segmentation.

scale_plan.sensor: AIRS Aqua Dust Score / MODIS context
VIIRS NOAA-20 Corrected Reflectance + Deep Blue AOT/Aerosol Type support
scale_plan.role: plume localization and pixel-level support mask

data_sources.name: NASA GIBS / Worldview
data_sources.use: AIRS Dust Score, VIIRS corrected reflectance, VIIRS Deep Blue support layers

data_sources.name: NASA POWER hourly point API
data_sources.use: wind, humidity and temperature support evidence

display_policy: Use this as the default AOI for the dust-agent screenshot path. Current red masks remain rendered-product support/demo layers until sensor-specific model inference is executed.
round_note: Round 025 keeps the Hexi Corridor AOI and replaces the weak high-resolution no-data thumbnail with a selected Sentinel-2 supporting context scene.
